837 auxano {owx-an'-o}

a prolonged form of a primary verb; TDNT - 8:517,*; v

AV - grow 12, increase 7, give the increase 2, grow up 1; 22

3) to grow, increase

   3b) of infants
   3c) of a multitude of people
   3d) of inward Christian growth
